summary: IO Interactive's abrasive co-op crime shooter series, including the mobile adaptation of Dead Men.

entries.title: Kane & Lynch: Dead Men
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version for main play; mobile adaptation for preservation only

emulation.emulator: Native Windows or mobile preservation environment
emulation.notes: Use Windows for the main run; preserve the mobile adaptation only if legally accessible.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC version, with mobile adaptation as separate low-fidelity content

primary.why: Kane & Lynch: Dead Men released on Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360, with a separate mobile phone adaptation. Windows is the highest-fidelity route for the full console/PC game; the mobile version is a secondary preservation route because it is a distinct adaptation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively where legally owned; check the mobile adaptation only through lawful preserved installs or footage if documenting every version.

secondary.exclusive_content: Mobile shooter adaptation with 38 levels across five scenarios
secondary.what_to_play: Sample or document the mobile adaptation separately from the main Windows run.
secondary.why: The mobile version is a distinct adaptation rather than a straight fidelity downgrade.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.
